description: AI-specific regulation. A fast-moving area — the EU AI Act is the first broad horizontal regime; other jurisdictions use sectoral or principles-based approaches. Expect rapid change.

regulatory_bodies.name: DIFC Commissioner of Data Protection (Regulation 10 — autonomous systems)
Information Commissioner's Office (AI and automated decision-making guidance)
California Privacy Protection Agency (automated decisionmaking technology regulations)

regulations.name: Artificial Intelligence Act
regulations.extra_territorial_scope: Applies to providers and deployers outside the EU whose AI system outputs are used in the EU.
sector_applicability: all — wherever AI systems are placed on the market, put into service, or used
regulations.summary: Risk-based regulation of AI systems. Tiers: prohibited practices, high-risk systems, limited-risk transparency, and general-purpose AI models (with additional obligations for systemic-risk models).
key_requirements: Prohibition of unacceptable-risk practices (social scoring, real-time biometric ID in public spaces with exceptions, etc.)
Conformity assessment for high-risk AI (biometric ID, employment, credit scoring, essential services, etc.)
Transparency obligations for AI systems interacting with natural persons and for synthetic content
Provider obligations on general-purpose AI models, including systemic-risk models
Registration in EU database for high-risk AI
Post-market monitoring and serious incident reporting

regulations.name: DIFC Data Protection Regulation 10 — High-Risk Processing Activities (incl. autonomous systems)
regulations.summary: Specific rules for autonomous / AI systems processing personal data in the DIFC.
key_requirements: DPIA required for autonomous systems processing personal data
Transparency to data subjects about autonomous processing

regulations.name: California Automated Decisionmaking Technology regulations (CPRA)
regulations.summary: Rules on automated decisionmaking technology under CCPA/CPRA — consumer rights to access, opt-out, and receive meaningful information about ADMT use.
key_requirements: Right to access information about ADMT logic and outcomes
Right to opt-out of ADMT (with exceptions)
